style: Chanson-cabaret acoustic folk and brass-band vaudeville. Harmony uses 11-limit just intonation pure ratio intervals with modal drone fields and parallel triads moving as a single block. Melody features angular cabaret patter and front-rounded vowel melismas opening into soaring falsetto arcs. Rhythm runs polyrhythmic 3-against-4 and 5-against-4 coexistence over additive Balkan-style asymmetric meter and steady metallic mbira pulses. Timbre deploys bright metallic mbira tines, upright bass slap, brushed snare, and acoustic wood resonance with chest percussion slaps. Performance delivers theatrical motivational seminar overstatement played completely straight with deadpan urgency. Production provides a dry close-miked acoustic room capture with abrupt tape stops and concentric spatial ring separation.
